Why Your Deployed AI App Can't Connect to Its Database

when a deployed app can't connect to its database, read the exact error before you touch code. ECONNREFUSED or a timeout usually means the app server's IP isn't on the database allow-list. ENOTFOUND is DNS (wrong host).
